description: Report a UI issue by pointing at it, prepare an agent handoff, and verify the rendered fix

humanFlow.purpose: Open the local app in Studio and click 'Report UI issue'
Hover over the broken element and click it; Studio shows a plain-language summary
Describe the problem in the 'What is wrong?' field
Describe the expected result in the 'What should happen?' field
Click 'Prepare agent handoff'; Studio shows 'Handoff ready' with a copyable agent prompt/ID for the user's coding agent
After the agent changes code, click 'Verify fix'; Studio reloads (cache-bust) and recaptures the element
Review before/after evidence and choose 'Accept fix', 'Issue persists', or 'Needs follow-up'. A changed screenshot is evidence, not truth — Studio never auto-accepts

technicalSection.description: Exact machine-facing MCP call order for agent integrations (advanced)

recommendedCallSequence.purpose: Navigate the browser to the target URL
Capture the current visual state of the target element
Edit the source file identified by the highest-confidence existing source hint
Create a before/after visual review from the captured issue
Re-capture the same element after the fix and compare against the before snapshot
Retrieve the full comparison (pixel ratio, bounding box delta, evidence deltas) to verify the fix

safetyNotes: Never output redacted values. If a value appears as [REDACTED] or [TOKEN_REDACTED], treat it as sensitive.
Do not modify files outside the project scope (node_modules, .git, system files).
Pass reload:true and cacheBust:true to recapture_visual_review after local file edits.
The reviewId from create_visual_review must be reused for recapture_visual_review and get_visual_review.
Before capturing, navigate the browser to the target URL with viskod_navigate if the session was not already started there.
A changed screenshot does not prove correctness: always let the human accept or reject the fix.
validationChecklist: Studio shows a redacted target summary after clicking the element
Studio requires non-empty 'What is wrong?' and 'What should happen?' fields
Studio shows 'Handoff ready' with a copyable handoff ID
comparison.visual.boundingBoxDelta reports the expected layout change
comparison.evidence.consoleDelta and networkDelta reflect reduced errors after the fix
No daemon-token or sessionToken appears in any output
